entries.note: PMID 19307358, epub 2009-03-23; quote verbatim in abstract (microM rendered μM). Untested opener stands; tegobuvir's 2007 phase 1 is tier 5 and HCV-796 is not a member, so no earlier admissible opener.

PMC3370793 body read via fc.py: the 8 NNPolIs are ABT-072, ABT-333, filibuvir, IDX375, MK-3281, setrobuvir, tegobuvir, VCH-222 (6 members); model 'predicts VL decreases within about 0.5-log10 units'. Fill product_in_model true, magnitude within_2x.

Quote verbatim, MedR line 978, but that sentence is a reviewer error (25-100 mg/day is ombitasvir's range); Reddy Table 1: ABT-333 400/800 mg BID observed -1.08/-0.95 log10 vs -1.3 predicted. Direction-only same holds; swap the quote.

Reddy ran the VK model in 2012 on published 2007-2011 monotherapy results ('observed clinical data were used to assess this prediction'): a model run after the clinic knew the answer. Propose retro, retrodiction true, same year.
entries.adjudication_note: Decision 10: the model result (Reddy 2012) post-dates and is motivated by the 2007-2011 monotherapy data it was fitted to; earlier inputs do not make it prospective. Reproduces them: retro, never same. Decision 8: in-silico system is a track.

entries.note: Quote verbatim, PharmR lines 201-203 (dasabuvir: rat 6-month, dog 9-month, no target organ). Margin held at 250 mg BID. model_first_use_year 2014 is the review year; the tox studies predate the 2008 FIH (NCT00696904).
Same PMID 19307358; quote is the verbatim first clause of the resistance sentence. Untested opener stands; the resistance prediction it sets up is never scored in a later entry (see missing).

PMID 24428468, print 2014-01-16; quote verbatim in abstract. NCT01464827 and NCT01716585 results both posted 2015-01-06. SAPPHIRE-I DOI is 10.1056/NEJMoa1315722 (PMID 24720703, SVR12 96.2%). ClinPharmR line 579 confirms the component-removal arms.

PMID 24927607 (Ann Hepatol 13(4):364-75, no DOI); quote verbatim in abstract; NCT00987337 results 2014-01-27, primary SVR at week 72. Contra by the letter; the source attributes the miss to post-treatment relapse, which the replicon cannot test.

Quote verbatim, ClinPharmR line 682; PharmR model side confirmed; no dasabuvir-attributed harm, same holds. Tegobuvir's 2007 QT signal and the 2011-09-04 Gilead dosing halt are tier 5 without a tier 1-3 model source; listed in missing.
PMID 17908950 abstract verbatim ('log(10)'); epub 2007-10-01, PMC2167986 open. Untested opener, class level, sibling A-837093 so product_in_model false. First author is Chen, not Long.

entries.note: Same abstract, sentence verbatim; Y448H/G554D/D559G (1a) and C316Y/G554D (1b) are the next sentence. Untested opener stands; whether a resistance-pathway opener belongs in efficacy is carried on index 5.

entries.rule: decision 4 (efficacy scores the trial's primary endpoint; endpoint_role null here); open rule question 4
entries.note: MedR line 1291 verbatim; lines 3190-3192 list C316Y, Y448H(E446K/A450V), G554S, D559G, so all four chimpanzee positions recur and the pathway matches. But no primary endpoint is compared and the monotherapy-rebound prediction was never run in patients; same only if the adjudicator seats resistance comparisons in a cell. Krishnan 2015 patient_trials quote near-verbatim.
entries.adjudication_note: Decision 4: efficacy scores the trial's primary endpoint (or a poc_gate secondary); a resistance-substitution overlap compares neither, and the chimpanzee's monotherapy-rebound prediction was never run in patients. Untested. Re-score same/direction_only if rule question 4 seats resistance comparisons in efficacy.

entries.rule: decision 7 (#112: a model opens at its first class use, proxy allowed)
entries.note: PMID 23322441 abstract verbatim; Ohara 2011 (PMID 21145818) used nucleoside MK-0608, so not an NNI use. But Kneteman 2009 (Hepatology 49:745, PMID 19072827) ran the SCID/Alb-uPA chimeric mouse with the NNI HCV-796 ('a 2.02 +/- 0.55 log reduction in HCV titer was seen with monotherapy') and states a correlation with its trials; non-member, so unscorable, but it dates first class use to 2009 if a non-member proxy counts as it does for A-837093.

PMID 25942724 abstract verbatim; SVR12 primary met 87-98%, JAMA 2015-05-05, no registry results. Direction-only same holds (decision 4 case 2); caveats stand: 3-DAA regimen is a superset of the mouse's NS5A+NNI pair, no NNI-free arm, 74% GT1a vs the mouse's GT1b eradication. Class level correct.

PMID 29916799 abstract verbatim (received 2018-01-22, online 2018-06-19). JGV body is JS-loaded/paywalled; no PMC, Europe PMC or open copy, so whether the DCV/ASV-failure serum donor was one of the four treated failures, and whether the mice were dosed before those patients relapsed, is unverifiable. Ximency was approved in Japan Dec 2016, so both arms ran in 2017. If the mouse followed the patients, decision 10 makes it retro. Patient level and product_in_model true are right; strengthens matches lint.

missing: Chimpanzee (HCV-infected) dosed with A-837093, Abbott's palm-I benzothiadiazine sibling of dasabuvir: Long 2007 AAC doi:10.1128/AAC.00723-07 — 1.4/2.5 log10 decline (GT1a/1b) with rebound and C316Y/Y448H/G554D selection on 14-day monotherapy. Patient side: ABT-333/ABT-072 3-day monotherapy ~1.0-1.1 log10 (Reddy 2012 Table 1) and dasabuvir RAVs S556G/C316Y/M414T (Kati 2015; Krishnan 2015 AAC doi:10.1128/AAC.00998-15). No track in the draft; product_in_model false.

Human-hepatocyte chimeric (uPA-SCID) mouse with an NNI (BMS-821095, sibling, product_in_model false): Shi 2013 Gut doi:10.1136/gutjnl-2012-302600 — NNI monotherapy broke through with resistant variants; NS5A+NS5B combination eradicated GT1b. Patient side: beclabuvir inside DCV-TRIO (UNITY-2, Muir 2015 JAMA doi:10.1001/jama.2015.3868). No track in the draft.

Replicon resistance-pathway prediction compared in patients, never scored: filibuvir M423 selected in dosed patients (Wagner 2011 Hepatology doi:10.1002/hep.24342; Troke 2012 AAC doi:10.1128/AAC.05611-11), matching Shi 2009's M423T; dasabuvir S556G/C316Y/M414T in AVIATOR failures (Krishnan 2015 doi:10.1128/AAC.00998-15), matching Kati 2015; lomibuvir+telaprevir DUAL arm stopped for breakthrough (Di Bisceglie 2014 doi:10.1097/MEG.0000000000000084). A 2011 same on the replicon track would precede both 2014 entries.

Beclabuvir is a second approved member: Japan, Ximency (daclatasvir/asunaprevir/beclabuvir), PMDA review https://www.pmda.go.jp/files/000226231.pdf (tier 2, approved Dec 2016); UNITY-2 Muir 2015 JAMA doi:10.1001/jama.2015.3868 (SVR12 in compensated cirrhosis); model side Lemm 2014 AAC doi:10.1128/AAC.02495-13 (replicon EC50 3-6 nM GT1a/1b, P495 resistance, liver-to-plasma 1.6-60x). The context note's 'only dasabuvir … reached approval' is wrong; a same entry strengthens the replicon track.

Tegobuvir safety, tier 5 patient side only: Gilead PR 2007-11-04 ('In the second multiple dose cohort, a possible but not confirmed QT elongation was observed'; dedicated QT study started) and Gilead PR 2011-09-04 (GS 9190 dosing halted in two four-drug PEG/RBV+PI trials after two serious adverse events, in consultation with FDA; nature undisclosed). No tier 1-3 model source for a tegobuvir hERG/cardiac prediction found (Shih 2011 AAC doi:10.1128/AAC.00307-11 abstract silent; a 2018 SAR paper doi:10.1016/j.bmc.2018.04.029 says analogues improved hERG 'over tegobuvir'). Needs a model_src before it can score; the 2011 halt is a class failure the draft does not show.

Registry checked for the unscored failures: setrobuvir NCT01903954 (SVR24 primary) and NCT00978497, tegobuvir NCT00743795 (24/48 wk + PEG/RBV) have no posted results, so the draft's 'not scored' for those members stands.
rule_questions: Sub-year ordering: on one track the filibuvir contra (registry 2014-01-27) precedes the dasabuvir same (pairable only from the Kati epub 2014-12-22), but lint orders by year and the draft lists same first. Should the schema carry a month/date, or should a December pairing be dated by print year 2015?

A replicon-predicted antiviral that improved on-treatment response but failed the SVR primary through post-treatment relapse after a 24-week response-guided stop: contra (primary-endpoint rule) or untested (result attributed to a condition the model cannot test)?

Is a viral-kinetic PK/PD model run in 2012 on already-published monotherapy results a model-system track at all; if so, is it retro under decision 10 even though its inputs (replicon EC50,PS and measured Cmin) existed before each trial?
Which cell scores a resistance-pathway prediction (replicon-selected substitution later found in treated patients): efficacy, engagement, or none?
Deleobuvir (BI 207127), a thumb-I NNI whose Phase 3 HCVerso programme was stopped and which Reddy 2012 names, is absent from the member list. In or out?

(models) Does a table row quoted cell-by-cell (verbatim cell contents joined with '|') satisfy the quote rule's 'sentence ... verbatim', or does the absence of a prose sentence force untested? Chimpanzee engagement 2012 rests on Reddy 2012 Table 1.

(models) Restates open question 4 for the chimpanzee track: a resistance-pathway prediction (sibling-selected NS5B substitutions recurring in dasabuvir-treated failures, no primary endpoint compared) scores in efficacy, engagement, or neither?

(models) For model_first_use_year under #112 (proxy allowed), does a non-member molecule of the class from another sponsor count as first class use (HCV-796 in the chimeric mouse, Kneteman 2009), as A-837093 does for the chimpanzee, or must the proxy be a member's own sibling?

(models) When one paper reports the model and the patient series together without stating which ran first (Teraoka 2018), does decision 10 default to prospective on the authors' framing or to retrodiction until the order is shown?
